workbench.title: Payment approval

sources.title: Business brief · paragraph 1
sources.text: A Finance Maker can search for an unpaid payslip and submit a Mark as Paid request. Paid payslips cannot be submitted again.

sources.title: Business brief · paragraph 2
sources.text: Payment method and payment date are mandatory before a request is submitted. A payment date must be a valid calendar date.

sources.title: Business brief · paragraph 3
sources.text: For a payslip amount greater than zero, payment method lists bank names only. For a zero amount, it lists Previous Advance, Scholarship & Waiver, and Semester Drop.

sources.title: Business brief · paragraph 4
sources.text: A duplicate transaction ID for the same bank must be blocked before submission, with a failure recorded in the audit log.

sources.title: Business brief · paragraph 5
sources.text: A Finance Checker can approve or reject a submitted request. The Maker cannot approve their own request.

sources.title: Business brief · paragraph 6
sources.text: A payslip becomes Paid only after the required approval is complete. Until then, its payment status remains Unpaid.

sources.title: Business brief · paragraph 7
sources.text: A rejected request remains Unpaid and returns to the Maker for correction and resubmission. A rejection reason is mandatory.

sources.title: Business brief · paragraph 8
sources.text: The system records submissions, approval decisions, and validation failures with the actor, timestamp, payslip number, and changed values in an audit log.
